basics.name: Anushree Ganta
basics.label: Full-Stack Engineer
basics.summary: Frontend-focused Full-Stack Engineer with technical expertise in building high-performance, responsive web applications and high-volume eCommerce platforms using JavaScript/TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, and Node.js. Skilled in mobile-first UI architecture, REST/GraphQL APIs, CI/CD, and Core Web Vitals optimization.

work.name: Google (via GlobalLogic)
work.summary: Architected scalable web platforms, analytics dashboards, and automated PLM workflows powering Google's Global Supply Management operations in Agile environments using the Atlassian suite.

Engineered full-stack analytics dashboards and automated data pipelines (BigQuery, Cloud SQL, REST APIs), modernizing legacy infrastructure and boosting system reliability by 35%.

work.name: eDiligence
work.summary: Engineered interactive data visualization dashboards and modular client/server-side architectures to track real-time agile development metrics.
highlights: Architected an interactive Agile analytics platform using React.js, Redux, and D3.js, visualizing complex telemetry and sprint velocity within Atlassian toolsets (Jira/Confluence).
Designed component-driven UI libraries using Material-UI (MUI) and SASS, and built high-performance Node.js & Express REST APIs with MongoDB schema optimization.

work.name: Accenture Pvt. Ltd.
work.summary: Spearheaded full-stack feature development, UI component modularization, and web performance optimization for high-volume enterprise eCommerce platforms.
